$comment: Compose project loading shared by kiln-builder (agent/internal/builder/composeproject.go) and the control plane's preview (Sites ComposeProject). Each case: repository files, the compose files (-f order) and profiles, and either the merged document or an error substring. Relative paths come out rebased to the repository root.

repo.compose.yaml:
services:
  web:
    build: .
    volumes: ["./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro", "data:/data"]
    env_file: .env.example
volumes:
  data: {driver: local}

cases.name: file in a folder: paths resolve against its directory

repo.docker/compose.prod.yml:
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: ../api
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ./conf/api.ini
        target: /etc/api.ini

repo.compose.yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27
    environment: ["A=1", "B=2"]
    ports: ["8080:80"]
    volumes: ["./site:/usr/share/nginx/html"]
    command: ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
    labels: {team: web}
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: postgres:17
repo.compose.prod.yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.28
    environment: {B: "3", C: "4"}
    ports: ["8443:443"]
    volumes: ["./dist:/usr/share/nginx/html"]
    command: ["nginx"]
    labels: ["tier=edge"]

cases.name: -f files resolve against the first file's directory
profiles: only the active ones run

repo.compose.yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
      debug: {condition: service_started}
  db:
    image: postgres
  debug:
    image: busybox
    profiles: [debug]
  worker:
    image: app
    profiles: [jobs, all]

cases.name: include: an included project merges first, with its own directory

repo.compose.yaml:
include:
  - infra/db.yml
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    depends_on: [db]

cases.name: extends: same file and another file

repo.compose.yaml:
services:
  base:
    image: app
    environment: {LOG: info}
    depends_on: [db]
  worker:
    extends: base
    command: work
  web:
    extends:
      file: common/web.yml
      service: http
    environment: {PORT: "8080"}
  db:
    image: postgres

cases.name: configs and secrets files are references

repo.compose.yaml:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    configs: [site]
    secrets: [key]
configs:
  site: {file: ./conf/site.conf}
secrets:
  key: {file: secrets/key.txt}

cases.name: absolute, home and interpolated paths stay as written
a compose file outside the repository is refused
